text:
Priya: Heads-up — the EU ingest lag spiked at 03:12 UTC and triggered a pretty big recompute job for hourly aggs. I'm seeing quota exhaustion on the priority lane.
Marco: Oof. Which job exactly? slice id?
Priya: slice=eu-2026-03-20-03, delta-mode. It spilled into full-agg fallback after we hit the 90% shard failure threshold.
Sam: Snapshot of the quota UI? small screenshot?
Priya: pasted the console alert: 

`[ALERT] backfill-allocator: tenant=tier-prod, lane=priority, available_slots=2, requested_slots=64`

Priya: backfill-bot also posted: "allocated 0 of 64 due to tenant quota cap"
backfill-bot: Tenant quota cap reached; attempted fair-share fallback to standard lane.
Emily: Does the console have an option to auto-hedge to preemptive fractional-slices? We keep losing work when a single slice trips the full-agg fallback.
Marco: Not today. Current routing is: try-priority -> if no capacity then fall back to standard -> if too many deltas, switch to full. No mid-ground.
Sam: Could we surface a hedging toggle in the API and console that does: attempt N extra small-slice retries in parallel across lanes with a soft quota allowance? Calling it hedge=true on the start API.
Priya: I sketched an API prototype:

```
POST /api/v1/backfills
{ "slice_id": "eu-2026-03-20-03", "mode": "delta", "priority": "high", "hedge": true, "hedge_policy": "fractional:4" }
```

Marco: Implementation concerns: soft quota needs billing/chargeback. Also risk of double-processing increasing S3/compute cost. Need time-window dedupe.
Emily: We have the prefix-KV cache that can dedupe replays for 60s per key, might be enough for short hedged retries. But longer-run full-aggs still a problem.
Sam: UX question: how would ops trigger this in console? a checkbox "allow hedged retries (temporary extra cost)" with an estimated cost delta?
Priya: Yeah — console could show estimated slot-hours and a small slider: 1x/2x/4x hedging. Default off.
Marco: Routing logic sketch:
1) try priority lane up to base slots
2) if blocked and hedge=true, try fractional-slices across spare slots in dedicated pools with a temp soft-cap bump
3) if majority succeed, commit; otherwise escalate to full-agg fallback

Sam: Need an abort leash for hedged work so we don't keep running if the root job resolves. Also a fast path to cancel hedged retries via API.
Priya: Agreed. Add `cancel_if_committed: true` flag.
Emily: From telemetry, early hedging might reduce full-agg escalations by ~35% on similar incidents, per past dry-runs. Worth a pilot.
Marco: Data to surface: per-tenant hedged-run cost, success rate, and latency delta. We'll add a console graph and a per-run breakdown.
Sam: Can we do a small canary: enable hedge for tier-beta tenants for 24h and route only 10% of priority traffic through it?
Priya: Yes. I'll open a canary rollout ticket.
Marco: Ops runbook additions: how to rollback hedging, how to revoke soft cap, and billing dispute contact.
backfill-bot: Created canary ticket #CB-712. Canary flag=eng-platform.hedge.beta=true.
Emily: Also add a safety measure: limit hedged retries to N=8 total per slice and max extra slot-hours per-tenant/day.
Sam: I'll mock the console UX and the API schema (OpenAPI patch) and post in this thread tomorrow.
Priya: Thanks — for now I'm manually moving the current job to standard lane to stop the SLA alert. Will keep monitoring.
Marco: Good call. Follow up checklist: API schema, console slider mock, billing calc, KV dedupe window limit, runbook blurb.
Sam: I'll PR the OpenAPI changes and a short e2e integration test.
Priya: Appreciate it.
Emily: ✅
Priya: tagging @oncall just in case latency spikes — it's stable now.
backfill-bot: Canary ticket updated to `in-progress`.
